name: WCT Holdings Berhad
overview: 2026年，WCT Holdings Berhad 通过全资子公司 WCT Land Sdn Bhd 以 RM140,000,000 收购 Jelas Puri Sdn Bhd 剩余 30% 股权，使其成为全资子公司，属于 Property Development 板块的扩张。其他业务线在所提供的公告中未见具体业务动态。
overview_en: In 2026, WCT Holdings Berhad, through its wholly-owned subsidiary WCT Land Sdn Bhd, acquired the remaining 30% equity interest in Jelas Puri Sdn Bhd for RM140,000,000, making it a wholly-owned subsidiary, which is an expansion in the Property Development segment. No specific business developments were noted for other business lines in the provided announcements.

segments.name: 房地产开发
segments.note: 今年通过收购 Jelas Puri Sdn Bhd 剩余 30% 股权，扩大在该项目公司的权益。
segments.note_en: This year, expanded its interest in the project company by acquiring the remaining 30% equity interest in Jelas Puri Sdn Bhd.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: WCT Land Sdn Bhd 以 RM140,000,000 向 EPF 收购 Jelas Puri Sdn Bhd 剩余 30% 股权（93,000,000 股普通股）。
actions.text_en: WCT Land Sdn Bhd acquired the remaining 30% equity interest (93,000,000 ordinary shares) in Jelas Puri Sdn Bhd from EPF for RM140,000,000.
